text: Area residents contacted my office regarding the possibility of having an all-way stop control installed at the intersection of Franklin Avenue and Antler Street. Residents informed me that it is extremely unsafe to turn from Antler Street to Franklin Avenue due to reduced sightlines, and quite frequently, speeding oncoming traffic. Residents further informed me that there is school pick-up/drop-off activity on Antler Street, which adds more traffic to this intersection. I asked Traffic Operations staff to look into the possibility of having an all-way stop control installed at this intersection; however, was informed that it is not technically warranted. I have since consulted with area residents, who generally support the installation of an all-way stop control at this intersection as a means to enhance safety in their neighbourhood.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized compulsory all-way stop control at the intersection of Franklin Avenue and Antler Street.
